propositions: Provider-prefixed model references (e.g. 'anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai_prices.calc_price raise LookupError and are silently converted to unpriced rows
The LookupError is caught and suppressed without warning at usage_log.py:429, causing rows to drop from cost totals with no visible indicator
Anthropic and OpenAI rows fail to price while Bedrock rows incidentally succeed, creating an asymmetric and misleading provider cost comparison bias
Cost reporting ('est. cost excludes N unpriced calls') appears to exclude models that genai-prices actually knows, creating confusion about pricing coverage
The fix must translate provider-qualified model refs to resolvable forms using registry membership rather than prefix matching or string splitting
